message: On Apple Watch, Add and Groceries are now buttons in the top corners instead of at the end of the list, task rows show their reminder time, and tasks coming up later today are listed under Today. Swipe a task to move it to tomorrow. A task that asks a question on completion can now be answered on the watch (yes/no, pick one, text or a number), and one that still has to be finished on your iPhone says why. Checking something off gives a tap on the wrist. There's a new Groceries complication, and each complication opens its own page. In a workout, double tap logs the set or skips the rest, and the set screen fits on smaller watches.
